labels.no_hindsight: every field read here is listed as knowable in the pre-registration; settlement outcome, resolution side and realized_usd are not read at all
labels.floor: min(up,dn) - spent: what the position is worth if the side held least wins. A past choice is judged on the floor it could have secured, never on which side actually won
labels.book: an OPEN/EXTEND price IS the BBO touch by construction, so the order rows recover the book; COMPLETE carries opp_ask and l5_touch_px directly
